# Changelog

All notable changes to this project are documented here. Entries are generated by [semantic-release](https://semantic-release.gitbook.io) from [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org), and the project uses [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/).

plugins.releaseBodyTemplate:
<% if (branch.prerelease) { %>> [!NOTE]
> **Beta:** this build isn't signed with a Developer ID or notarized yet, so macOS says it can't verify the app. Open the disk image, drag **Fan Controller** to Applications, then remove the quarantine flag once:
>
> ```sh
> xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Fan Controller.app"
> ```
>
> Or open it once and choose **Open Anyway** in **System Settings › Privacy & Security**. The beta reads every sensor but can't control fans; see the [README](https://github.com/furkansenturk/mac-fan-controller#download).

<% } %><%= nextRelease.notes %>
